|descr= Sets flag [[Side]]. A flag may be taken by any unit that is enemy to the side that owns the flag. Just like with [[setFlagTexture]], if the command executed where unit is [[Multiplayer Scripting#Locality|local]] effect of the command will be global and [[Multiplayer Scripting#Join In Progress|JIP]] compatible.

|s1= flag [[setFlagSide]] side

|p1= flag: [[Object]]
|p2= side: [[Side]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_flag1 setFlagSide east;</sqf>

|x2= Capturable OPFOR flag:
<sqf>
private _flag = "FlagPole_F" createVehicle position player;
_flag setFlagTexture "\A3\Data_F\Flags\Flag_CSAT_CO.paa";
_flag setFlagSide east;
</sqf>
